title: AI Mario 64 Freerun #1
description: The curiosity-driven AI run from the YouTube video (105,480 frames, about 59 minutes)

title: Noise benchmark: white vs pink, seed 1
description: The original curiosity GA (population 128, 600-frame genomes, 1-frame commit) from the start menu with different gamepad noise. Distinct 333-unit voxels / horizontal cells at each game time.

table.note: White leads early; pink overtakes it after about 17 minutes. One seed each, so not conclusive; seeds 2 and 3 and brown-noise variants are running. The white replay ends at 36,000 committed frames (its last save before the run was stopped). Frame numbers include the 1,680 start-menu frames.

title: Noise benchmark: batch 2, completed runs
description: The finished 30-minute curiosity runs from the second noise batch, compared at the same checkpoints as the seed-1 table. Distinct 333-unit voxels / horizontal cells at each game time.

table.note: Runs that stopped early are marked: walk seed 1 (frame 44,590) and brown seed 1 (frame 47,190) hit a twin/game mismatch in Bob-omb Battlefield, so scores after that point aren't reliable. Their replays end at the last saved checkpoint, 42,000 and 45,000 committed frames, before the mismatch. Columns show distinct voxels / horizontal cells; the 30:00 column is the value at the stop for stopped runs. Frame numbers include the 1,680 start-menu frames.

title: Noise benchmark: batch 2, still running
description: The rest of the second batch, compared at 30,000 committed frames (about 16 game minutes), the point every run has reached. Voxels and horizontal cells are cumulative; numbers will change as the runs finish.

table.note: Brown-stick seed 2 hasn't reached 30,000 frames yet. The two runs that stopped early (walk seed 1, brown seed 1) are in the completed table. Frame numbers include the 1,680 start-menu frames.
